definitions.explanation: The body of law that sets out how lawsuits are conducted — the rules of court procedure — as opposed to substantive law, which defines rights and duties. Divided mainly into civil and criminal procedure.

examples.japanese: {民事|みんじ}{訴訟法|そしょうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: to study the code of civil procedure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進|すす}め{方|かた}→進め方：08081_susumekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{訴訟法|そしょうほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The way a trial proceeds is prescribed by procedural law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧{実体法|じったいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}し→対する：02126_taisuru⟧、{訴訟法|そしょうほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: In contrast to substantive law, which defines the content of rights, procedural law prescribes the procedures for realizing those rights.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧ (litigation, lawsuit) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law). A collective term for the laws governing court procedure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民事|みんじ}{訴訟法|そしょうほう}: the Code of Civil Procedure
- {刑事|けいじ}{訴訟法|そしょうほう}: the Code of Criminal Procedure
- {訴訟法|そしょうほう}⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: procedures under procedural law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実体法|じったいほう}: substantive law — defines rights and duties themselves, the counterpart to procedural law
- ⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧: a lawsuit; litigation — the proceeding that procedural law governs
